mapping_basis: Pictures follow the intake naming convention: NNN.jpg is the first picture whose own Facebook caption states stanza #N; NNN-2.jpg and later are further pictures for that stanza; nostanza-NN.jpg have no stated stanza and stay unmapped. A picture whose caption labels several stanzas (for example "#5 & #6") is mapped to each of them. Source photos are contextual references only; canonical Sanskrit governs scene interpretation.
missing_stanzas_reason: no Facebook pictures or captions in the intake for this dasakam
